teljes kódot kijavítva vissza küldöd. minden egyes karaktert leírsz, nem rövidítesz. minden hibát kijavítasz. egy fájl marad. ne írj semmi mást csak a teljes kódot es kommentek nem lehetnek benne! soha semmi egyszerusitett mock placeholder dummy szimulalt fake szart nem engedelyezek es teljes fájl roviditetlen production ready kód  egy kód mezőbe írjad a teljes kódot es legyen 100% osan hiba mentes! 
DIM ← 18432
GRID ← 5

LorenzEmbed ← {
  σ ← 10
  ρ ← 28
  β ← 8 ÷ 3
  dt ← 0.01
  x0 ← 0.1 × 𝕩
  y0 ← 2 × 𝕨
  z0 ← 0
  x1 ← x0 + dt × (σ × (y0 - x0))
  y1 ← y0 + dt × (x0 × (ρ - z0) - y0)
  z1 ← z0 + dt × (x0 × y0 - β × z0)
  phase ← (1 ⊸ ○ x1) × (2 ⊸ ○ y1) × (1 ⊸ ○ z1)
  sinphase ← 1 ⊸ ○ phase
  cosphase ← 2 ⊸ ○ phase
  out ← phase‿sinphase‿cosphase‿σ‿ρ‿β‿x1‿y1‿z1 ⩴ (DIM - 9) ⥊ 0
  out
}

BSplineBasis ← {
  deg 𝕊 knots‿x:
  deg = 0 ? ((x ≥ knots) ∧ (x < 1 + knots)) ∾ (≠ knots - 1) ⥊ 0;
  prev ← BSplineBasis (deg - 1) 𝕊 knots‿x
  leftDen ← knots ⊸ (deg) - knots ⊸ (0)
  rightDen ← knots ⊸ (deg + 1) - knots ⊸ (1)
  left ← (x - (knots ⊸ (0))) ÷ leftDen × prev
  right ← ((knots ⊸ (deg + 1)) - x) ÷ rightDen × prev
  left + right
}

KanSplineEval ← {
  coeffs‿grid‿x 𝕊 𝕩:
  knots ← (grid - 1) ÷ ↕ grid
  basis ← BSplineBasis 3 𝕊 knots‿x
  +´ basis × coeffs
}

Trim ← { ((𝕩 ≠ ' ') ⊸ /) 𝕩 }

Lower ← { 𝕩 - 32 × ((𝕩 ≥ @ + 'A') ∧ (𝕩 ≤ @ + 'Z')) }

GraphToId ← { 𝕩 - @ }

GetBirth ← { 𝕨 ⊑ 𝕩 }

HybridTokenize ← {
  text‿grid‿birth 𝕊 𝕩:
  norm ← Lower Trim text
  len ← ≠ norm
  indices ← ↕ len
  tokens ← {
    char ← 𝕨 ⊑ norm
    id ← GraphToId char
    idx ← 𝕨
    lorenz ← idx LorenzEmbed id
    degree ← idx GetBirth birth ∾ (len ⥊ 0)
    phaseshift ← (1 ⊸ ○ (0.1 × idx)) + degree
    lorenzshift ← phaseshift + lorenz
    splinex ← idx ÷ len
    coeffs ← (grid ⥊ 1) × 0  # produce zero coefficients of correct shape
    splineval ← KanSplineEval coeffs‿grid‿splinex
    finalemb ← 0.01 × splineval + lorenzshift
    id‿finalemb
  } ¨ indices
  tokens
}

Main ← {
  text ← "JAIDE V33 BQN compute core"
  tokens ← HybridTokenize text‿GRID‿⟨25.52,18.58,15.27⟩‿@
  "Hybrid BQN Compute Core Loaded for JAIDE V33 LLM"
}

Main @

  σ ← 10
  ρ ← 28
  β ← 8 ÷ 3
  dt ← 0.01

  y0 ← 2 × 𝕨

  x1 ← x0 + dt × (σ × (y0 - x0))
  y1 ← y0 + dt × (x0 × (ρ - z0) - y0)
  z1 ← z0 + dt × (x0 × y0 - β × z0)
  phase ← (1⊸○x1) × (2⊸○y1) × (1⊸○z1)
  sinphase ← 1⊸○phase
  cosphase ← 2⊸○phase
  (phase‿sinphase‿cosphase‿σ‿ρ‿β‿x1‿y1‿z1) ‿ ((DIM - 9) ⥊ 0)
}

BSplineBasis ← { p 𝕊 knots‿x:
  Helper ← {
    i‿p_rec ← 𝕨
    SafeDiv ← {d←𝕩; (d=0) ? 0 ; 𝕨÷d}
    p_rec = 0 ? ((x ≥ i⊑knots) ∧ (x < i+1⊑knots)) : {
      
      num1 ← x - i⊑knots
      den1 ← (i+p_rec)⊑knots - i⊑knots
      term1 ← (num1 SafeDiv den1) × (Helper (i‿p_rec-1))

      num2 ← (i+p_rec+1)⊑knots - x
      den2 ← (i+p_rec+1)⊑knots - (i+1)⊑knots
      term2 ← (num2 SafeDiv den2) × (Helper (i+1‿p_rec-1))
      
      term1 + term2
    }
  }
  n_basis ← (≠knots) - p - 1
  {Helper (𝕨‿p)} ¨ ↕n_basis
}

KanSplineEval ← {
  coeffs‿grid‿x ← 𝕩
  d ← 3
  n ← grid
  interior_knots ← (1+↕n-d-1) ÷ (n-d)
  knots ← ((d+1)⥊0) ‿ interior_knots ‿ ((d+1)⥊1)
  basis ← BSplineBasis d 𝕊 knots‿x
  +´ basis × coeffs
}

Lower ← { •U2C (c←•C2U 𝕩) + 32 × (c ≥ •C2U 'A') ∧ (c ≤ •C2U 'Z') }

GraphToId ← { •C2U 𝕩 }

GetBirth ← { (𝕨 mod ≠𝕩) ⊑ 𝕩 }

HybridTokenize ← {
  text‿grid‿birth ← 𝕩
  norm ← Lower Trim text
  len ← ≠norm
  indices ← ↕len
  tokens ← {
    idx ← 𝕨

    id ← GraphToId char
    lorenz ← idx LorenzEmbed id

    phaseshift ← (1⊸○(0.1×idx)) + degree
    lorenzshift ← phaseshift + lorenz
    splinex ← idx ÷ len
    coeffs ← grid ↑ lorenzshift
    splineval ← KanSplineEval (coeffs‿grid‿splinex)
    finalemb ← 0.01 × splineval + lorenzshift
    id‿finalemb
  } ¨ indices
  tokens
